backlogged.summary: init.mjs's action→word map conflates 'inserted' and 'updated' into the same displayed text ('updated'), so the CLI message can't distinguish 'block added after the first heading' from 'existing block rewritten'; no criterion checks this distinction so it's harmless but slightly confusing.

blockStatus/harness claude-md --check compares the block's version marker to package.json's version with exact string equality, so every core patch release marks every project's block 'outdated' even when templates/claude-block.md content is unchanged, prompting a rewrite nag on each release. This matches the literal SPEC text (version compared, not content) so it's not a defect, just a design note for future consideration.
